title: round.js stage args
description: The args the dispatcher passes to round.js once per round; round.js hands the stage subsets to its child workflows.

runNs.description: this run's namespace, minted in Dispatch

workflowsDir.description: this skill's deployed workflows/ dir, absolute; round.js only

baseHealth.description: {build, tests} at the base, for the station

lanePlan.description: the lanes call's lane plan; lanes stage

idFloor.description: the finding-id floor the lanes call prints; lanes stage

knownPath.description: the round's known-findings ledger; every stage

laneModel.description: lane agent model from the lanes arg

laneEffort.description: lane agent effort from the lanes arg

overlayPatch.description: the overlay-patch arg path, empty without it

prebuilt.description: the prebuilt arg, empty without it

excludes.description: the exclude arg as an array, empty when absent
